mappings.condition: Apply to the identity event payload without changing its existing IRIs.
The event supplies a stable document_id and title.
The event carries its assertion_id, subject or pending reference, predicate IRI, object, valid interval and provenance.
The event names the assertion it retracts.
The event carries stable sensor and platform entity IRIs.
The event carries stable observation, sensor, feature and result IRIs.
The event carries a track id, entity id and any explicitly referenced observation ids.
Emit for each assertion or document represented by a log event.
Use the persisted event IRI only for events that generate an assertion, document or track RDF entity.
The corresponding AssertionMade or DocumentRegistered event generated the existing entity IRI.
The assertion source_ids includes a document_id registered somewhere in the same event log; external source citations remain in the canonical core:hasSource graph.
TrackObserved explicitly lists the observation id and an ObservationRecorded event for that id exists in the same log.
The sensor IRI is already present in SensorRegistered or ObservationRecorded event data.
ObservationRecorded supplies the distinct result IRI.
ObservationRecorded.at_time is the observed-world time; never substitute the event log's occurred_at as sosa:resultTime.

A geometry CSV row names a location typed core:Location in the projection, has a unique absolute location IRI and source IRI, and gives finite longitude/latitude within their respective ranges. The WKT CRS is CRS84 and its coordinate order is longitude then latitude.
The geometry CSV source_iri is registered as a DocumentRegistered document; otherwise retain it only as dcterms:source citation.
